# Setup
cd backend
.venv\Scripts\Activate
pip install -r requirements.txt


# Run the app (from backend/, venv active)
uvicorn app.main:app --reload
# docs UI: http://127.0.0.1:8000/docs


# Tests
pytest


# --- Alembic (DB migrations) ---
# run these from backend/, venv active

# apply all pending migrations (this is how you "run" migrations)
alembic upgrade head

# after changing a model in app/models/, generate a migration for the diff
alembic revision --autogenerate -m "describe the change"
# review the generated file in alembic/versions/ before applying it, then:
alembic upgrade head

# show current DB revision
alembic current

# show full migration history
alembic history

# undo the last migration
alembic downgrade -1

# undo all migrations back to empty
alembic downgrade base

# mark DB as being at a revision WITHOUT running its SQL
# (only for baselining/fixing drift, not normal use)
alembic stamp head


# --- Docker (Postgres container) ---
docker ps                                   # confirm container is running
docker exec -it dbsupportpg psql -U postgres -d postgres   # open psql shell
